CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The good life of Jesus Christ.
   C. Apply the teaching of The good life of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The good life of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Wise men? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wise men.
   B. Use Wise men to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Wise men has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Wise men with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible? (1 mark)

   C. Say The Bible has no place in daily life.

   D. Use Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

8. Which response best shows understanding of Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible.
   C. Say Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
